parityAcceptance: resolved metadata is deterministic and source-attributed
record values override scoped defaults without destroying inherited values
collection and taxonomy defaults remain independently configurable
canonical and alternate URLs are locale-aware and pagination-safe
social and JSON-LD output can be disabled independently
redirect loops and chains are rejected before publication
404 observations never enter the content Git repository
legacy SEO fields remain readable throughout migration
beyondParityAcceptance: preview and published resolution share one contract
operational reports use opaque identifiers and redact query secrets
multi-site URL fixtures cover both domain and subdirectory strategies
